findings.claim: Expected-red confirmed: compositor._repolish_tree fails to reach descendants - TWO independent defects. (A) 'from qtpy import QtWidgets' early-returns (qtpy is not importable at this seat -> the density repaint no-ops entirely). (B) a premature 'break' right after findChildren extend -> only the root is repolished even when qtpy is present. Density QSS never reaches child widgets. Pre-existing spawn W5-ROPE-DENSITY-REPAINT.

Expected-red confirmed: compositor._apply_spec collapses one-way. 'if spec[collapsed]: widget.setMaximumHeight(0)' has NO restore branch, so a switch-back never un-collapses. Micro-probe: maxHeight stays 0 after a collapse->uncollapse cycle. Prominence (written unconditionally) resets two-way; collapse does not.
